text:
alex: Heads-up — trying to onboard az-model-13B weights, running into strange kernel selection failures in Triton during unit tests.

maya: oof. which Triton/CUDA combo are you on?

alex: Local dev image uses CUDA 11.8 + Triton 22.12.0, but our docker base for the runtime was recently bumped to CUDA 12.1 for some other models. Logs show `unregistered op` and kernel fallback to CPU for certain flash-attn paths.

liam: do we have the weights location? I can try repro on my workstation (12.1).

alex: weights are at s3://redwood-models/az/az-13b/v1/weights.tar.zst — model-config in the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/462

katie: also check tokenizer: az uses a slightly different BPE merger (missing <|pad|> token) — caused weird token id shift in our tests last time.

alex: good catch, katie. I verified vocab.txt: indices match but the tokenizer uses legacy `mergeable_ranks` flag. Added note in PR.

maya: kernel selection errors usually point to mismatched cuBLAS/flash-attn kernels. Can you paste the runtime debug dump?

alex: paste of relevant snippet:
```\n[2026-02-03T14:22:11Z] kernel_selector: chosen_kernel=fp16_flash_attn_v2\n[2026-02-03T14:22:11Z] triton_loader: incompatible_kernel: flash_attn_v2 requires cu>=12.0, found 11.8\n[2026-02-03T14:22:11Z] fallback: using reference_attention_cpu\n```\n
liam: there we go — runtime base image (for hosted runtime) is still CUDA 11.8. The Dedicated image was already on 12.x so staging vs prod mismatch.

katie: what's the plan? rebuild container with CUDA 12? Might affect other models that rely on 11.8 kernels.

maya: two options: 1) backport/install alternative flash-attn kernel compiled against 11.8 for az-13B, or 2) move runtime base to CUDA 12 and validate other models. Option 2 has broader impact but simplifies kernel support.

alex: for short-term, I'd prefer backport so we can validate az-13B without a full rebuild. I hacked a build script to compile flash-attn locally — got past kernel selection but then hit a tokenizer mismatch failing end-to-end tests.

katie: tokenizer mismatch could be due to our container packaging — we vendor `tokenizers` wheel pinned to 0.13. If az needs 0.14 it could reorder merges. Which version does az-model require?

alex: az-config lists tokenizers==0.14.1. Our runtime has 0.13.3.

liam: that explains. Two parallel upgrades needed: tokenizers and kernel. Both require container rebuild.

maya: can we do a focalized rebuild image: base CUDA 11.8 + tokenizers 0.14 compiled against same wheel + backported flash-attn? If successful, we'll push to staging only for az tests.

alex: I'll try a staged Dockerfile, will push branch `eng/az13b-runtime-patch`. Pushed initial changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/981 — build CI will test.

build-bot: CI triggered for runtime/pull/981 (job: build-runtimes — linux-cuda-11.8)

maya: pinging @katie for tokenizers wheel review and @liam to validate kernel compile flags. If we green CI, we can run canary in staging.

katie: I can build the wheel tonight and upload to our wheelhouse. Any specific compile flags?

liam: use `-DUSE_CUDA=1 -arch=sm_80` and ensure cudnn headers match 11.8. Also set `NO_AVX512=1` for compatibility on our VMs.

alex: noted. Also added a small config validation check to the model onboarding script to fail early if `tokenizers` version mismatch or if `model_config.json` contains `rotary` fields not supported by runtime. Example output: `ERROR: tokenizer version mismatch (required 0.14.1 != runtime 0.13.3)`

maya: good addition — prevents us running long tests with silent failures. Can you add a short README snippet in the PR explaining the adjacency issues (CUDA/Triton vs tokenizers)?

alex: done. README added.

build-bot: runtime/pull/981 — build completed: partial success. Unit tests passed, integration tests failing on e2e_tokenizer_check.

katie: I'm uploading wheel now to internal wheelhouse at wheelhouse.internal/tokenizers/0.14.1.whl

liam: I'll trigger a manual build of the flash-attn backport and attach artifact to the PR.

alex: thanks — will re-run CI once both artifacts are in. If green, can we schedule a staging canary for tomorrow 09:00 PST?

maya: yes, I'll coordinate with SRE. @sre-bot can you reserve a staging slot for `az-13b-canary` at 09:00 PST tomorrow?

sre-bot: Reserved staging slot `az-13b-canary` at 2026-02-04T09:00:00-08:00. Reminder will post 30m prior.

katie: quick note: flagging potential perf delta — tokenizers 0.14 introduced a memory perf improvement but changed byte-to-token mapping on some inputs; added a test case to models repo to catch regressions.

alex: wrapping up: action items — alex: finish CI rerun, liam: compile/backport kernel artifact, katie: upload wheel, maya: staging slot + canary plan. Will ping here once staging runs. :thumbsup:

liam: on it.

katie: uploading now.

maya: thanks all.

alex: final note — logging the root cause in the onboarding checklist so future models run the validation script before CI long tests.
